tracks.title: Fly And Collision Of Comas Sola

verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1971 (Germany).

physical: Pressed by Deutsche Grammophon Gesellschaft Pressing Plant

notes.text:
Early repress with catalog number extended to six digits (2nd pressing). First catalog number is on sleeve, second one is on B-side label.
Cover variation: artist's name is added to front sleeve artwork (top right corner).

Recorded at The Dierks Studios Stommelen / Koeln
Produced and directed for Ohr / Metronome Records

The music material of this album was felt by Tangerine Dream
This album is dedicated to all people who feel obliged to space

15. OHR-Platte
P. 1971

Laminated gatefold sleeve.

Pressing plant identified by 31mm press ring on labels.
"ST-OMM-56.012-A/B PF" is etched in runouts, all the rest is stamped.
